pick.headline: France expels 47 Soviet diplomats and officials for espionage
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 5, 1983, carried Paris AFP in English on France ordering 47 Soviet diplomats and officials out, 'the biggest intelligence clean-up' in Franco-Soviet relations, with a Moscow source confirming the TASS Paris bureau chief was among them.

alternates.headline: Bomb wrecks La Belle discotheque in West Berlin
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of April 7, 1986, carried Moscow TASS in English on the La Belle blast: two dead, some 150 injured including 30 to 50 Americans, framed around the Soviet Union's stated rejection of terrorism 'in all its manifestations'.

alternates.headline: Kuwait Airways Flight 422 hijacked to Mashhad
alternates.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of April 6, 1988, listed under Kuwait further reportage on the hijacking of the Boeing 747, with a Saudi SPA 'source' voicing concern and the Iraqi government condemning the hijack of the Kuwaiti plane.
